Road Accidents in Uttar Pradesh Kill Multiple People

Two separate road accidents occurred in Uttar Pradesh. In one incident, a speeding car collided with motorcycles, resulting in two fatalities. In another accident on the Ganga Expressway, a speeding Thar vehicle overturned, killing four people and injuring a teenager. Specific locations and further details on the circumstances of the accidents were not provided in the coverage.
